description.zh: 加速域名，仅支持启用单个。
description.en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request.

descriptions.zh:
- 如果域名处于非法状态或域名对应账户欠费，您将无法正常调用该接口启用加速域名。
- 单用户调用频率：100次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- If the domain name is in an invalid state or you have an overdue payment in your account, the domain name cannot be enabled.

- Each account can call this operation up to 100 times per second.
